<script>document.documentElement.classList.add('js');</script>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Besley:wght@800&family=Libre+Franklin:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --bg: #e5e1d8;
  --surface: #dad5ca;
  --deep: #cdc6b8;
  --paper: #f1eee8;
  --ink: #2a1d17;
  --muted: #6b5b51;
  --accent: #456f3a;
  --accent-strong: #36592d;
  --accent-ink: #ffffff;
  --on-dark: #e5e1d8;
  --on-dark-soft: #bfb3a6;

  --display: 'Besley', Georgia, serif;
  --text: 'Libre Franklin', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;

  --step-small: 0.9375rem;
  --step-body: clamp(1.0625rem, 1rem + 0.25vw, 1.1875rem);
  --step-lead: clamp(1.25rem, 1.1rem + 0.6vw, 1.625rem);
  --step-head: clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 2.6vw, 3.5rem);
  --step-display: clamp(1.875rem, 4.3vw, 5.25rem);

  --m: clamp(20px, 2.3vw, 32px);
  --header: 68px;
  --gap-section: clamp(120px, 12vw, 200px);

  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --ease-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1);
  --t-press: 140ms;
  --t-hover: 180ms;
  --t-ui: 240ms;
  --t-reveal: 800ms;
  --stagger-item: 80ms;
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; scroll-padding-top: calc(var(--header) + 16px); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { html { scroll-behavior: smooth; } }
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--text);
  font-size: var(--step-body);
  line-height: 1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}
h1, h2, h3, h4, p, ul, ol, dl, dd, figure, blockquote { margin: 0; }
ul, ol { padding: 0; list-style: none; }
a { color: inherit; }
button, input { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
::selection { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.skip { position: absolute; left: var(--m); top: -60px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--on-dark); padding: 10px 16px; z-index: 100; text-decoration: none; }
.skip:focus { top: 10px; }

.display { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 0.98; }

/* ---------- buttons and links ---------- */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px;
  background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink);
  border: 0; border-radius: 0;
  font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--step-small); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform var(--t-press) var(--ease-out), background-color var(--t-hover) ease, color var(--t-hover) ease;
}
.btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
.btn--small { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; }
.link {
  text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.25em;
  text-decoration-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 35%, transparent);
  transition: text-decoration-color var(--t-hover) ease;
}
.link .arr { display: inline-block; transition: transform var(--t-ui) var(--ease-out); }
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .btn:hover { background: var(--accent-strong); }
  .link:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
  .link:hover .arr { transform: translateX(4px); }
}

content.text:
The Rotaline landing page is built as a single `index.html` and opens directly from disk. I checked it in a real browser at 1440, 768 and 390px wide. The page-checking tool reports one remaining failure: on phones your headline wraps to three lines instead of two (details below).

**Design approach**
- **Layout:** a split page. The left side is a dark panel holding the product's schedule view. It stays fixed on screen while the right side scrolls through the hero text, customers and features.
- **Fonts and colours:** Besley for headings and Libre Franklin for text. The colours are bone, chocolate brown and green.
- **The illustration is a working schedule.** It shows a real week of named shifts in the visitor's own time zone, with a live "now" marker and a countdown to the next handoff. Visitors can switch it between daily, weekly and follow-the-sun rotations, and approve or decline a sample swap request.
- **The fixed panel changes as you read the features.** It shows the schedule, then an alert moving through escalation steps, then a handoff note.

**How each section works**
- **Header:** on small screens the links collapse into a "Menu" button.
- **Features:** set as a printed duty sheet with zigzag top and bottom edges, grouped into "Before the shift", "During the shift" and "At the shift change".
- **How it works:** a slider with three numbered stops. Each stop changes both the step text and a matching product screen.
- **Results:** your three figures, next to a fairness report chart of on-call hours per person.
- **Testimonials:** shown as comments in the product.
- **Pricing:** three coloured blocks whose heights step up by plan. Team is labelled "Most popular". The monthly/annual toggle switches $9/$7 and $16/$13 and shows the yearly total.
- **FAQ:** expands and collapses, one answer open at a time.
- **Footer:** the four link columns, the copyright line, and a full-width "Rotaline" that grows slightly as you scroll to the bottom of the page.

**Where I departed from the brief or the design guide**
- **Phone headline:** your headline is 55 characters, so at 390px it runs to three lines at 32px. Fitting it on two lines would need about 21px type, so I kept your exact wording at a readable size.
- **Final call to action:** "No credit card required." is on its own line under "Start a 14-day free trial." The wording is unchanged.
- **No photos or video:** the design guide asks for real photos and a video clip, but your rule against remote images rules them out. Every picture on the page is built in HTML or inline SVG.

**Things to replace before launch**
- **Sign-up form:** it isn't connected to anything. Submitting shows a made-up confirmation message.
- **Business plan button:** it opens an email to `sales@rotaline.example`, a placeholder address.
- **Copy I wrote that isn't in your brief:** all FAQ answers; the team names and incidents in the product screens; the fairness report numbers; the testimonial dates and "Acknowledged" counts; and the sentences under each plan.
- **Statement presented as fact:** the FAQ says SMS and phone alerts have no per-message fees. Confirm that before publishing.

I also deleted the design tool's working folder (`.taste-skill/`, which held its screenshots and notes), so `index.html` is the only file I left behind.
